# Sweep Orchestrator

> Hyperparameter sweep orchestration built from scratch: multi-fidelity scheduling (successive halving and Hyperband), parallel early stopping, multi-objective Pareto optimization, and hyperparameter importance analysis.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator

## Source

- [src/sweep_orchestrator/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/__init__.py): Sweep Orchestrator - multi-fidelity scheduling and multi-objective sweeps from scratch.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/cli.py): Command line interface for the sweep orchestrator.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/data.py): A bundled, deterministic sweep problem used for demonstrations and evaluation.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/evaluation.py): Measure what pruning and multi-fidelity scheduling save.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/hyperband.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/hyperband.py): Hyperband: hedging over how aggressively to prune.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/importance.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/importance.py): Hyperparameter importance via variance decomposition.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/pareto.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/pareto.py): Multi-objective optimization: Pareto fronts over conflicting objectives.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/pruning.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/pruning.py): Early-stopping pruners for the parallel runner.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/runner.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/runner.py): The parallel sweep runner: execute trials concurrently with pruning.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the sweep orchestrator.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/successive_halving.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/successive_halving.py): Successive halving: the core multi-fidelity primitive.
- [src/sweep_orchestrator/types.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/sweep-orchestrator/blob/main/src/sweep_orchestrator/types.py): Core types for sweeps: configurations, trials, and objective callables.
